diagnostics.source: Supplied diagnostic data and coordinator's independent analysis; archive instructions were not executed

reported_results.observation: Asynchronous provider end remains ending while Gateway records cleanup_required; repeated status does not advance cleanup.
Parent acquire/reconcile receives HTTP 409 while the exact child operation remains uncertain.
Emergency close was reported during the failed device run; no automated device success is inferred.

correction.provider_terminal_owner: ChildTerminalOperation polls the same provider end binding for at most 20 seconds, with one-second spacing and RPCs bounded by the remaining budget (at most 8 seconds), allowing the real ten-second Bridge grace period.
correction.retry: Exact host retry resolves its active permit before acquire. Status and housekeeping progress the same owner. Original game-only intent survives timeout and retry.
correction.stream_close: Provider confirmation precedes active-permit-checked snapshot and close. A fully specified idle snapshot reconciles lost close responses without another global close.
correction.restart: Child terminal metadata remains in the existing durable control journal; the existing in-memory response index is reconstructed from succeeded operations.
correction.parent_close: Authorized parent recovery requires matching client, execution profile, stream ID, app ID and generation. The child owner performs effects and the parent receives a durable succeeded receipt.
correction.android: Child overlay full quit uses terminateChildSession; suspend stays hidden and game-only stop retains. Heartbeat is 30000 ms and host charges the full delta. Terminal poll is 1000 ms. Child end/status and parent terminal acquire permit 40000 ms for bounded host cleanup.
